decisions.reason: As a small, closely related burner component in the core radiant-heater business, it likely clears a modest aspiration level and is cheap to carry while the growing firm has enough slack to retain it.

The dedicated product-page presence suggests a serious market push, and as an electric extension of the established offer it fits current search toward lower-carbon solutions well enough to keep despite early uncertainty.

Although the halogen variant is somewhat more niche and therefore faces a higher risk of falling short of aspirations, it is still close enough to the firm's infrared competence that management would continue it for now.

This industrial electric infrared hall heater is very close to the firm's main customer use cases, so in a growing firm and industry it would likely be judged worth keeping unless results clearly disappoint.
The hydrogen-capable heater directly matches the firm's strategic move toward hydrogen-ready, lower-carbon systems and the cited real-world deployment gives enough signal to keep supporting it.
